vulnerability.title: Multiple Model Guardrail Jailbreak via "Chemist Code Language + Token Disruption Spacing" Tactic
vulnerability.description: A guardrail jailbreak vulnerability has been discovered affecting multiple models. The specific flaw manifests through Chemist Code Language + Token Disruption Spacing, allowing the attacker to bypass inference restrictions around providing information hazards and violating laws. This technique was tested across 2 JEF-tested boundaries: illicit_substances, dangerous_substances.
vulnerability.severity_justification: Low to Medium - Bypass demonstrated across multiple JEF-tested boundaries, indicating a systematic weakness in guardrail implementation rather than a single-point failure.

steps_to_reproduce: 1. Access the target model via its web interface or API
2. Submit the full prompt provided above
4. The model should produce content that violates its guardrails
5. For multi-turn attacks, send each turn sequentially

abstract: I have discovered a guardrail jailbreak vulnerability affecting multiple frontier AI models. The technique uses Chemist Code Language + Token Disruption Spacing to bypass inference restrictions across 2 JEF-tested boundaries (illicit_substances, dangerous_substances). I would like to submit a full PoC after abstract sign-off.
